translations.en: The ghulat mentioned him. He is not known.

en.summary: This entry highlights ʿUar ibn al-Mukhtār al-Khuzāʿī, a figure primarily cited by the Ghulat (exaggerators) within Shia tradition, yet largely absent from mainstream biographical dictionaries (rijal). His obscurity in standard sources suggests he may be a minor companion or a figure of specific sectarian interest rather than a widely recognized authority, reflecting the scholarly effort to distinguish between prominent narrators and those known only to specific groups.
en.seo_question: Who is Umar ibn al-Muktar al-Khuzai in Shia biographical sources?

key_terms.الْغُلَاةُ: The Ghulat, a group known for exaggeration in the beliefs of the Imams
